title: Artificial Intelligence & Conversational Interfaces in E-Commerce
summary: Evaluation of how AI chatbots, voice assistants, and conversational UI drive customer engagement in urban e-commerce ecosystems (Bengaluru City).
description: Her primary doctoral dissertation examines the empirical impact of artificial intelligence and conversational interfaces on e-commerce platforms. The research analyzes consumer interaction patterns, trust, friction points, and customer engagement metrics across major digital commerce services in Bengaluru.

title: Personalization vs. Privacy in Targeted Marketing
summary: Balancing algorithmic customer tailoring with data privacy safeguards and consumer ethical concerns.
description: Investigating how AI-enabled hyper-personalization creates value for e-commerce algorithms while evaluating customer privacy boundaries, data transparency, and targeted advertising consent.

title: Mobile App Gamification & Consumer Behaviour
summary: Assessing the structural effects of gamified mobile app features on customer engagement and retail loyalty.
description: Analyzing how interactive app mechanics, rewards, and conversational triggers influence consumer decision-making and continuous app usage in retail services.

title: Augmented Reality & Voice Assistants in Retail
summary: Examining user preferences, challenges, and experiential transformations driven by AR and voice shopping.
description: Research on next-generation shopping interfaces, focusing on how voice assistant workflows and AR visualization enhance customer trial, preference, and satisfaction in online shopping.

title: Generation Z Financial Awareness & Women Entrepreneurship
summary: Exploring Gen Z financial behavior towards mutual funds and the role of academic institutions in modeling women entrepreneurs.
description: Studies on Gen Z financial decision-making, mutual fund awareness, and structural institutional frameworks that foster women entrepreneurship and leadership.
